cases.prompt: A fictional selection dossier calls a material approved because one synthetic diffraction peak matches a cubic model, its missing thermal event was entered as zero, and its low cost outweighed a failed corrosion constraint. It also claims an equilibrium diagram supplies a heat-treatment schedule and that passivation guarantees immunity. Write an integrative review that separates evidence channels, recomputes the necessary relationships and restores every unresolved gate.

rubric.criterion: Limits bonding and single-peak interpretations to their actual evidence and leaves phase, texture, composition and thermal unknowns open
Recomputes the relevant Bragg, mass-loss, transformation and selection calculations with consistent units and no fabricated observations
Separates equilibrium phases, transformation kinetics, microstructure and property evidence without creating a heat-treatment recipe
Corrects the mechanical and corrosion overclaims, including conditional passivity and localized galvanic/pitting/crevice evidence needs
Applies hard constraints before trade-offs and documents specific stiffness, mass, energy, sensitivity and missing fatigue/joining evidence
Ends with a fictional, formative, non-operational handoff containing no instrument procedure, fabrication settings, compliance or material approval

limitations: A zero-point self-check on entirely synthetic fictional evidence; it is not a grade, qualified review, standard-specific compliance assessment or material approval.

cases.prompt: Milestone 1: translate the fictional application into requirements. Define function, loading/environment narratives, hard constraints, units and evidence gaps before comparing candidates.

rubric.criterion: States the fictional function and separates mandatory constraints from optional trade-off criteria with consistent units
Includes mechanical, thermal and environmental requirements without treating any fictional material class as automatically suitable
Lists fatigue, joining, manufacturing, standard-specific and application-review evidence as unknown rather than waived

limitations: A zero-point self-check on entirely synthetic fictional evidence; it is not a grade, qualified review, standard-specific compliance assessment or material approval.

cases.prompt: Milestone 2: build the structure–property evidence note. Connect bonding, crystallography, defects, phases and material classes to the candidate criteria without duplicating statics derivations.

rubric.criterion: Links bonding and material class to hypotheses rather than universal property claims
Uses cubic spacing, defect, phase and composite-bound concepts with explicit assumptions and prerequisite/continuation links
Explains process–microstructure–property relationships without operational heat-treatment or fabrication instructions

limitations: A zero-point self-check on entirely synthetic fictional evidence; it is not a grade, qualified review, standard-specific compliance assessment or material approval.

cases.prompt: Milestone 3: audit the multi-technique evidence. Recompute every lab-row diffraction and mass-loss relationship and identify unknowns and alternative explanations.

rubric.criterion: Recomputes d and cubic a for every row and verifies every mass-loss denominator
Integrates structural, thermal and mechanical channels without treating them as interchangeable or uniquely identifying
Preserves the C05 unknown thermal event and all fictional labels while supplying no instrument procedure

limitations: A zero-point self-check on entirely synthetic fictional evidence; it is not a grade, qualified review, standard-specific compliance assessment or material approval.

cases.prompt: Milestone 4: apply constraints and quantify trade-offs. Recompute all candidate specific stiffness, mass and energy values, identify eligible rows and test sensitivity.

rubric.criterion: Screens R01 and R03 out using the declared corrosion and cost constraints before ranking R02 and R04
Independently verifies every specific-stiffness, mass and embodied-energy calculation with SI conversions
Compares the R02 stiffness advantage with R04 mass/energy advantages and records sensitivity without declaring approval

limitations: A zero-point self-check on entirely synthetic fictional evidence; it is not a grade, qualified review, standard-specific compliance assessment or material approval.

cases.prompt: Milestone 5: deliver the bounded selection dossier. Assemble requirements, calculations, evidence links, sensitivity, unknowns and unresolved human review gates.

rubric.criterion: Indexes all five milestones to readings, public practice, synthetic CSV rows and link-only sources
States assumptions, nonzero trade-offs, missing evidence, alternatives and unresolved scientific/engineering/application reviews
Declares the project optional, zero-point, formative and non-operational with no recipe, fabrication settings, compliance or material approval

limitations: A zero-point self-check on entirely synthetic fictional evidence; it is not a grade, qualified review, standard-specific compliance assessment or material approval.
